scope:
Paused renderer laboratory, not gameplay/FPS evidence or character artwork.

Compare first-draw Canvas, settled source ImageBitmap and worker ImageBitmap.
Actual gameplay anatomy/animation has its own real input captures and videos.

comparisonPolicy.nativePath: ready cached ImageBitmap after pendingBitmaps settles
comparisonPolicy.rawRgbaEquality: reported, not assumed across DOMCanvas and OffscreenCanvas bitmap paths
comparisonPolicy.visible: 8-bit premultiplied RGB plus alpha, and source-over black/white/autumn-floor mattes
comparisonPolicy.toleranceReason: at most two 8-bit quantization steps for source tile bitmap transfer and raster snapshot; transparent RGB is not visible
comparisonPolicy.scope: backend raster equivalence only; does not certify anatomy or animation
